metadata.model_attribution: The OpenSim Development Team (Reinbolt, J; Seth, A; Habib, A; Hamner, S), adapted from a model by Kate Holzbaur (2004); discretized into sampled path polylines and transforms here.
metadata.coordinates: Ground coordinates; distances in meters; degrees shown for input. Shoulder elevation fixed at 0 degrees.
metadata.matrix_convention: 4x4 nested rows, column-vector multiplication p_ground = M * [x_body, y_body, z_body, 1].
metadata.sampling: 1-degree steps from 0 to 130 degrees, independently evaluated with OpenSim.
metadata.disclaimer: Kinematic poses only; no force, activation or forward dynamics. Muscle paths are OpenSim display polylines, not muscle volumes or clinical measurements. Do not assume interpolated positions are exact.
metadata.geometry_rights_note: Model license is declared within the .osim file. Rights of separately sourced mesh files should be verified before redistribution.
